# AI Heroes

> AI Heroes B.V. (Groningen, the Netherlands, KvK 42051968) builds AI tools your team uses every day, for organisations that want more than a pilot. Three ways in: a new AI tool, replacing old software that no longer fits, or running AI locally (on your own servers or with a European provider). Every build starts with the start sprint: an intake first, then six days at a fixed price, from EUR 8,000 (the same for all three ways in). It can start within two weeks of the first call and ends in a working prototype on the client's own data (not yet connected to their systems) or a build plan, always with the business case on one page. A build has a fixed price per project, from EUR 15,000, delivered in milestones with a demo at each; the start sprint fee is deducted from it. After delivery AI Heroes keeps maintaining and developing the system, priced separately in the business case. Organisations without a concrete idea yet start with an exploration (verkenning). Office: Aarhusweg 4-16, 9723 JJ Groningen. Contact: info@aiheroes.io, +31 50 200 3373.

AI Heroes bouwt AI-toepassingen die je team elke dag gebruikt, voor organisaties die verder willen dan een pilot. Drie ingangen: een nieuwe AI-toepassing, oude software vervangen of lokaal AI draaien. Elke bouw begint met de startsprint: zes dagen, vaste prijs, vanaf EUR 8.000, start binnen twee weken. Een bouw heeft een vaste prijs per project, vanaf EUR 15.000; de startsprint gaat daar af. Van ambitie tot implementatie. Vanuit Groningen, voor heel Europa.

## For agents

- [All pages as Markdown](https://aiheroes.io/llms-full.txt): the full text of every public page, Dutch first, then English
- Every page is also available as Markdown: add .md to its URL, for example https://aiheroes.io/en/start-sprint.md (the Dutch homepage is https://aiheroes.io/index.md), or request the page itself with Accept: text/markdown
- [MCP server](https://aiheroes.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): https://aiheroes.io/mcp (Streamable HTTP, read-only, no authentication) with the tools search, get_page, list_pages and get_company_facts
- [Agent skills](https://aiheroes.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): answering questions about AI Heroes, and getting in touch on a user's behalf
- [AI catalog](https://aiheroes.io/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): every agent resource on this site

## The AI Heroes standard (included in every build)

- Business case first: cost, return and payback on one page, before we build
- Compliance from the drawing board: AI Act classification, logging, human oversight, European hosting
- Your people can work with it: the team that will use the system is trained on that system (Article 4 of the EU AI Act)
- Not tied to one AI vendor: built model-agnostic, everything documented

- [The start sprint](https://aiheroes.io/en/start-sprint): six days, fixed price, from EUR 8,000, working prototype or build plan plus business case

- [A new AI tool](https://aiheroes.io/en/new-ai-tool): AI customer service, agents and workflows, administration, company wiki, digital twin, integrations, extra developers, custom software
- [Replace old software](https://aiheroes.io/en/replace-software): overpriced SaaS, Excel and legacy systems replaced next to the old system, moved over in phases
- [Run AI locally](https://aiheroes.io/en/self-hosted): AI on your own servers or in the European cloud, with the AI Act in the design
- [How we work](https://aiheroes.io/en/how-we-work): from start sprint to maintenance

- [Compliance and security](https://aiheroes.io/en/compliance): AI Act check, ISO 42001 guidance, security reviews
- [AI training for your team](https://aiheroes.io/en/training): part of every build; standalone training from EUR 2,500 per half day
